title: Climate targets
subtitleBefore: Set the decarbonisation goals this workspace reports against. Validated targets feed the dashboard
sbtiTooltip: Science Based Targets initiative — global standard for setting climate targets that align with the latest climate science (1.5°C / well-below 2°C). Validated targets are independently reviewed by SBTi.
tip: Tip — what auditors look for: a near-term SBTi target should be a reduction of at least 42% absolute by 2030 (1.5°C-aligned) versus a recent baseline. Long-term should reach net-zero by 2050 with at least 90% absolute cuts. Anything weaker won't validate.
